title: Dispositivo de seguridad y movilidad — Ajuntament de València, 45th Marathon (published 1 December 2025)
claims: For the 45th edition on Sunday 7 December 2025, 510 local police officers plus Civil Protection personnel and volunteers were deployed; the event gathered about 36,000 runners from 150 countries.
The race started at 08:15 in the Plaça del Marató with nine waves and was expected to finish around 15:10 inside the Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciències.

From Friday 5 December 22:00 the Puente de Montolivet closed both ways and Profesor López Piñero closed toward the centre for the start arch; Germans Maristes and Institut Obrer avenues had intermittent cuts Friday night and the closures ran again Saturday 22:00 to Sunday 14:00 apart from transversals.
EMT rerouted 32 lines; on race day lines C1, 19, 30, 31, 32, 40, 67, 70, 71, 73, C2, 81, 92, 93, 94, 95 and 98 were suspended, while 35, 99 and C3 served the start and City of Arts area.
Tram cuts on race morning: Line 4 between Pont de Fusta and Doctor Lluch 08:00-11:20; Line 6 suspended 07:30-11:20; Line 8 only from 12:30; Line 10 ran Alacant-Amad Granell-Montolivet until 10:00.
Runner car parks opened at 06:00 at the Oceanogràfic and Aqua shopping centre; alternatives were Cementerio General with EMT 99 and Natzaret with Tram 4.

Three controlled pedestrian crossings operated during the race: the Xàtiva metro underpass, Colón/Sorní and Colón/Porta de Mar; real-time traffic information was published via @transitvalencia, App Valencia, the municipal geoportal, Google Maps and Waze.
This device was published for the 2025 edition on 1 December 2025; the 2026 edition traffic arrangement was not yet published as of 2026-11-25.
